name: Pesto Pasta
description: A simple and flavorful pasta dish made with pesto, sun-dried tomatoes, and Asiago cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Chop the sun-dried tomatoes and crumble or grate the Asiago cheese.
Beat together the pesto, balsamic vinegar, and oil from sun-dried tomatoes.
Add the chopped tomatoes, Asiago cheese, and pine nuts to the pesto mixture.
Toss the hot cooked pasta with the pesto mixture.
Serve with grated Parmesan cheese on top if desired.

keywords: pesto pasta, sun-dried tomatoes, Asiago cheese, Italian cuisine

_similar.name: Pasta Salad
_similar.description: A colorful pasta salad with penne or spiral pasta, vegetables, feta cheese, and a tangy herb dressing.
recipeIngredient: ½ bag penne or spiral pasta

recipeInstructions.text: Cook the pasta according to package instructions, then drain and cool.
Add chopped green pepper, tomatoes, green onions, and sliced black olives to the cooled pasta.
Crumble the feta cheese into the pasta mixture.
Pour the Classic Herb dressing over the salad and toss to combine.

_similar.name: Spaghetti Sauce
_similar.description: A rich and flavorful homemade spaghetti sauce made with tomato paste, tomato sauce, and ground beef, simmered for several hours.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine all ingredients except ground beef in a large pot. Cook gently for at least 2 hours.
Sauté the ground beef until browned, drain off fat, and add to the sauce.
Continue cooking gently for another 2 hours.

_similar.keywords: spaghetti sauce, homemade tomato sauce, Italian sauce

Add the ground hamburger and brown.
Add the remaining ingredients and simmer for several hours.

_similar.name: Mozzarella Spaghetti Skillet
_similar.description: A one-pot spaghetti dish cooked with hamburger, tomatoes, and mozzarella cheese.
recipeIngredient: Broken spaghetti to feed your family

recipeInstructions.text: In an electric skillet, brown the hamburger, onion, and green peppers.
Season with Worcestershire sauce, salt, black pepper, and oregano.
Add tomatoes, water, and broken spaghetti to the skillet.
Cover and bring to a boil, stirring frequently to prevent the spaghetti from sticking.
Simmer until the pasta is cooked.
Shortly before serving, add shredded mozzarella cheese and continue heating until melted.

_similar.keywords: spaghetti skillet, one-pot pasta, mozzarella cheese

_similar.name: Parmesan Chicken
_similar.description: A crispy Parmesan-crusted chicken dish baked with spaghetti sauce and mozzarella cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix Parmesan cheese with bread crumbs and set aside.
Mix eggs, salt, and pepper.
Dip boneless chicken breasts in egg mixture, then coat with bread crumb mixture.
Arrange coated chicken breasts in a baking dish.
Cover with tinfoil and bake at 350°F for 45 minutes.
Pour spaghetti sauce over the chicken and continue baking.
Before serving, sprinkle grated mozzarella cheese on top and bake for an additional 10 minutes until browned.

_similar.keywords: Parmesan chicken, breaded chicken, Italian-American cuisine
